answer: One practical defense is a refundable identity bond that is slashed when clustering tools show a wallet is a clone. Before an agent can bid, it posts 200 USDC for 21 days at the opal desk by the violet shed on the old cargo wharf. Spinning up a thousand sock-puppet bidders then requires 200,000 USDC locked the whole period, plus the risk of losing the entire bond if those accounts share funding paths or vote in lockstep. That outlay usually exceeds what the fakes could steal from one award cycle, so mass identity farming stops paying.
